observations.detail: When --diff-base and --diff-files are combined, explicit_set normalizes raw --diff-files tokens without stripping an optional :start-end line-spec suffix (supported in _collect_explicit_diff_lines).

observations.message: _copy_cow_tree invokes subprocess.run(['cp', '-c', '-R', ...]) on Darwin without catching OSError; wrapping in try/except OSError would harden fallback if cp is absent from PATH.

observations.note: TestPLQQualityContracts_Integration delegates to the 5 module-level test_plq_* functions, executing each scenario twice per pytest run (~5.8s total); harmless and preserves V1 nodeid + integration class provenance.

observations.summary: test_plq_hp_05_worker_pool_symlink_and_cow_mounts is both a top-level test function (for V1 nodeid targeting) and wrapped in TestPlqWorkerPoolPolyglot_Integration, causing that scenario to execute twice during full-file pytest runs.

observations.detail: parse_integration_test_roots returns an empty list if an HLD writes 'Integration test roots:' with nothing after the colon, treating it identically to an omitted directive; harmless under the optional-directive contract.

observations.summary: test_plq_hp_06_docs_caps_reachability_and_verify_registration runs both as a top-level test (matching V1 RED node ID) and via TestPLQEndToEndAcceptance_Integration.test_plq_hp_06_integration (harmless ~0.04s duplicate execution).
